template.name: Up3x1 Investor
template.entry_long: close > open and (high - low) > atr(high,low,close,{p0}) and (close - open) > atr(high,low,close,{p1})
template.notes: The completed bullish expansion candle is represented with a body and range exceeding one ATR(14) as a normalized proxy because pip thresholds are not supplied. A bearish expansion is the failure exit; pip stop, target, and trailing levels are unsupported.
